description: The bar chart, titled “Recall@10,” visually compares the performance of four different methods in terms of recall at the top 10 recommendations. The vertical y-axis represents the Recall@10 score, ranging from 0.1 to 0.4 with major gridlines at 0.1, 0.2, and 0.3. The horizontal x-axis lists the four methods: “Ours” (in orange), “- critiquing” (blue), “- scoring” (blue), and “- ranking” (blue), suggesting that the latter three are ablated versions of the proposed “Ours” method. The “Ours” method achieves the highest Recall@10 score, approximately 0.35. The “- critiquing” variant follows with a score of about 0.28. The “- scoring” variant performs the worst, at approximately 0.16, while “- ranking” achieves a score of roughly 0.24. The chart uses color coding to distinguish the proposed method (orange) from its ablated variants (blue), and all bars are aligned vertically with consistent spacing, clearly indicating the relative performance degradation when components are removed.
